sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Bike-sharing after the novelty
passage.text: Bike-sharing arrived with promises of clean transport and crowded streets full of bicycles. Several cities now report a quieter outcome. Ridership peaks in the first year and then flattens, while maintenance costs keep rising. The companies that survive tend to be those that moved bikes to where people actually need them, near metro exits and housing estates, instead of scattering them across the centre. Parking rules matter as much as price. Where bikes may be left only in marked areas, streets stay tidy and the service is used more; where they may be left anywhere, the opposite happens.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: Where bikes may be left only in marked areas, streets stay tidy and the service is used more; where they may be left anywhere, the opposite happens.

answer.text: 在只允许把车停放在指定区域的地方，街道保持整洁，服务的使用率也更高；而在可以随意停放的地方，情况正好相反。

explain.right: 先切分意群定主干，再按汉语习惯重排语序，最后检查术语与指代是否统一。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：Where 引导地点状语从句，译「在……的地方」；the opposite happens 译「情况正好相反」，不要直译「相反发生」；两个分句保持对照。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 150 words on the following topic: bike-sharing schemes often lose users after the first year. Explain the reasons and suggest improvements.

answer.text: Bike-sharing schemes usually start with crowded streets and end with rows of broken bicycles. The novelty explains the early peak; the flat line afterwards has more ordinary causes. Bikes are placed where they are easy to park rather than where trips begin and end, maintenance is deferred until vehicles fail, and casual parking leaves pavements messy, which turns public opinion against the service. The fixes are practical. Operators should station bikes near metro exits and housing estates, set marked parking zones, and publish repair response times. Cities should treat the scheme as public transport, not as advertising space. Reliability, more than novelty, keeps riders.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：只描述「共享单车很方便」，没有分析第一年后使用量停滞的原因。

The fixes are practical. Operators should station bikes near metro exits and housing estates, set marked parking zones, and publish repair response times. Cities should treat the scheme as public transport, not as advertising space. Reliability, more than novelty, keeps riders.
